regeln.fall_wahl: Drawn evenly from 1-5 before the opening, stored internally as a number, never in plain text in logs or output. No choosing afterwards. Player actions change what Duc finds out, not the cause.
regeln.verhindern: The triggers lie outside Duc's options (no opening option prevents a deed).
regeln.fakten: Every important fact has content, time, source, reliability, who knows it and how it was passed on. Inner monologue is never another character's knowledge.
regeln.angst: The hidden fear of discovery only rises when the person learns about the investigation (ways with auffaellig=true, conversations, rumours). Searching in secret changes nothing.
regeln.gegenhandlungen: At most one per day. Each leaves a trace and has a way around it. No complete loss of evidence without an alternative way.
regeln.anklage: Confrontation only with a proven chain (one piece of evidence per link). Public accusations are possible but never marked as the truth while unproven. A public false accusation needs a public correction.
regeln.codex: Short, factual entries, split into log, statement and "Your suspicion". The character list gives nothing away through sorting or missing options (all suspects have the same options).
regeln.intim: No central clue exclusively behind sex. A gift or a sex scene heals no breach of trust. A love scene is no reward for a cover-up. Erotic privacy only becomes a rumour through an established witness or a voluntary disclosure.
regeln.sprachmodell: The model shapes dialogue and atmosphere within the facts. It invents no deed, no exclusive piece of evidence, no secret surveillance and no choosing the culprit afterwards. Characters only know what is in wissende/uebermittlung. New claims are claims and are checked against the facts.
regeln.notversorgung: Radio, emergency beacon, anchor light and bilge pumps are never part of a trade.
regeln.spoiler: Cases are only called case 1-5; fact IDs are neutral; check and build output only names numbers.

grundsaetze: A failed propulsion doesn't mean there's no power: hotel load in island mode, emergency supply independent.
A small consumer never destroys a propulsion system on its own: every chain runs through the shared weak spot (pre-damaged LM3 + badly documented R2).
The normal protection would have limited most triggers - that's why the second truth (Alon's component on LM3) is real in every case.

Failure and bang are two moments: the failure lies between 06:11 and 06:35 depending on the case, the bang in the inverter is always at 06:35 (the foreign component drives LM3 into runaway after the failure).
No forced diesel-versus-radio decision. Repair and towing compete for time, material, weather windows and hands.

technische_wege.reparatur: Replace or bridge LM3: spare module (Megan/Petru), diagnostic runs with Unit-01 (diesel), weather window, Rosi and Petru as hands.
technische_wege.schlepp: Salvage window through Elsa or Megan; a professional rescue is never morally inferior.
technische_wege.isolation: Isolate LM3 properly: fire risk eliminated, afterwards only slow or no motoring under her own power.
technische_wege.brand: Not in Act 1: LM3 exploded in the cold open (06:35), the inverter is destroyed.

zweite_wahrheit.kern: Alon's agent bought Totò through his cousin Gennaro (€20,000, "nobody gets hurt"); one night in Antibes Totò fitted a foreign component to LM3. It thermally pre-damaged the module and drove it into runaway after the failure - hence the bang at 06:35 in every case. The trigger from the case only gave it the final push. Alon's motive: a disaster instead of an advertisement for the bay, bad press, a low price.
zweite_wahrheit.hafen: For decades the Eden Group has owned the commercial harbour quarter of Cala d'Orsu (quay, warehouses, the land under Alva's bar). Megan is supposed to sell it; the buyer is A.V. Estates (she only knows the company name), and her promotion depends on the price. The Eden Bay Weekend (sunrise, Siri posts, Yasin films) is meant to drive the price up; the bang at 06:35 is Alon's countermove. The sale is not revealed before Act 2.
zweite_wahrheit.alon_korsika: A: remote and yet close (empty mountains, Monaco one night away, the Legion in Calvi -> Adrien's unit). B: the harbour is his logistics (cages, animals and equipment can't come over the mountain road; the resort is a pretext for cranes, warehouses and supply boats) -> he needs exactly the harbour quarter, cheaply. C: as a child he spent summers with his grandmother in Cala d'Orsu, before the diagnosis; as a boy he stood outside the Casanovas' house. The collars are a precursor to a nerve control meant to save his own body first and then patch humanity. The illness is no excuse.
zweite_wahrheit.bedeutung: Act 1 judges the trigger, Act 3 judges Alon. Totò's statements about the party night stay true; he only lies about the device. No Act 1 clue becomes false through the betrayal.
zweite_wahrheit.akt1_hinweise: Only observations without a chain function: red light (z_01), Totò dodges (z_02), Megan's hesitation (z_03), "A.V." (z_05), Totò's money (z_06). Lola's gossip "counts money at night" is only a signpost. Evidence in the propulsion room only from Act 2.

fruehstueck.kern: Cold open without explanation: 06:35, a bang in the propulsion room, smoke, sparks, Rosi's hand on the emergency stop. One breath, then black screen: "The day before. Antibes." Nobody is recognised, nothing is explained, no guilt is hinted at.

abend.kern: Party in the evening light, no cast list - and the first scene of the crime: what Duc sees here counts later as an observation. First: who do you help? Then moments: Lea claims the sea might glow tonight; Rosi calls Unit-01 the only guest who brings its own power; Sophia quietly separates Lea and Rosi; Holm has stomach pain and waves it off; Maxwell does a push-up for every joke; Chiara has an unused place cleared away (an image, don't explain). Group photo at 21:32 - Duc may be missing from it.

nacht.kern: Afterparty until half past three; Duc can't sleep and sits with Lola in the galley, who is baking for the sunrise breakfast. First the music stops. Then Lola says "Duc?". Only then the alarm. Don't name a time - exactly when it went quiet differs from case to case.

Totò and Lea run to the propulsion room after the alarm. At 06:35 (the same in every case) the inverter goes bang. Maxwell catches the debris with his back and saves Totò and Lea - just a scratch, he turns it into a pose. Sophia's charm drops when Lea is lying under the debris. Rosi runs in, hits the emergency stop and then sits still in front of the inverter for longer than ten seconds (only Duc sees it). Unit-01 keeps running. Everyone says "motor", Rosi corrects them: "It's not a motor. It's an inverter." Totò stares briefly at something behind the inverter and turns grey - don't explain. Holm asks whether everyone is okay, looks after Lola and then collapses herself.

Holm has dragged herself to the bridge and won't be relieved. The yacht drifts until she lies at anchor off Cala d'Orsu at 07:50. Holm, pale with pain, doesn't ask for his heroic biography but: "Who do you call when you don't know what to do next?" The answer comes back (farewell). At the end she mentions that her logbook and the log show different times.

After take-off there are too many cups on the table. Chiara wants to take one away. A small character choice, not a moral test.

Dialogue core: "Tomorrow you'll ask me about that night again." - Yes / Only if you want to talk / evade. Lola's invitation (side arc) may fill this slot.

optionen.nur_wenn: Only if you want to talk.

nacht.kern: A concrete message confirms or refutes an alibi (fall.nachtende). If Duc already knows, then - if the conditions are right - the invitation to a voluntary confession comes instead. No redundant surprise.

abend.kern: The whiteboard "Rosi vs. Officer" in the propulsion room: securing emergency power and the propulsion room, the first step of the repair in Act 1. A step succeeds or fails based on the work so far (material from the village helps). The person responsible can contribute decisively without becoming retroactively innocent.
Megan calls, calmer than on the first day and therefore scarier: tomorrow she'll come aboard herself and stay until the hearing. She wants to see the ship, not read reports.

fruehstueck.kern: At the end of breakfast the main story sets megan_besuch. The landing itself is played by the event g1_helikopter (day phase, mandatory).

tag.kern: Megan walks the ship. She studied navigation and naval architecture and can see from the damage that overload alone isn't enough - she doesn't say so. Duc decides whether he shows her everything, including what speaks against the crew (zweite_wahrheit.megan_haltung).

dinner.kern: In the evening a storm comes. Clear division of work: lines and anchor, saving power, securing the galley, securing the tender, checking the makeshift fix. Duc can't go with every person; those he sends out do traceable tasks and report with what they actually know. Megan watches and takes notes.

abend.kern: Foreshadowing: Duc hears Megan quietly on the phone on deck; she says "A.V." twice and something about "the buyer from Monaco". She notices him, hangs up and becomes the boss again. Don't explain who A.V. is; Megan herself doesn't know what she is working for.

nacht.titel: What You Hear in the Dark
nacht.kern: Storm: the power drops hard. An unchecked makeshift fix fails (a consequence, not a punishment roll); a prepared procedure prevents it and is played as teamwork. Megan sees the crew at work for the first time.

abend.kern: Mandatory breather after the storm: a fire on the little beach next to the yacht, Lola grills, Maxwell tells a story in the third person, Totò takes bets on who falls asleep first. The hearing is tomorrow - tonight nobody talks about it, until someone does.

nacht.kern: A shared evening, deliberately chosen, before the hearing. A love scene is possible, not a mandatory climax and no reward for a cover-up. The decisive statement can come afterwards or in an equivalent friendship scene: a promise the person wants to keep themselves.

tag.kern: Megan judges in the salon. Sequence: accusation -> two witnesses -> objection with evidence -> truth -> Duc's own role -> plea -> verdict (story anhoerung, kern/anhoerung.py). The hearing always takes place, even empty-handed. Here: accusation, witnesses, objections.
Duc's own role in the night: honest or kept quiet (counts towards mercy).

Plea (ask for mercy / share the blame / demand punishment) and verdict. Megan hesitates over the engine report: "A PX-480 doesn't just burn." Her gut feeling makes mercy possible if the code allows it.

abend.kern: The crew after the verdict. Megan flies out; from now on only by phone again. Whoever was wrongly suspected is waiting for a word from Duc. The outcome of the hearing colours the room but explains nothing new.

nacht.kern: Night, everyone is asleep. High in the mountains above the bay a red light is blinking, in the same rhythm as the one behind the inverter. Then a howl from the macchia, not a dog. Black screen: end of Act 1. Don't explain.

holm.regel: Holm is on board on the party day (day 1) and the morning after (in command) and is evacuated at the end of breakfast on day 2. What she knows in each case is in fall.holm_tag1; after that she can be reached by phone from the hospital.

megan.regel: Exactly once, by helicopter; she stays until the hearing (as judge) and flies out after the verdict. The main story sets the flag, no event sets it itself.

regeln.konkurriert_nicht: Lola's and Alva's personal stories take no main scene's place and cost no phase (an interlude after the phase).
regeln.keine_zeit: As in BG3: "Not right now" postpones the scene; the invitation comes back on the next suitable evening. No loss of trust for postponing.
regeln.tratsch: Lola's gossip (on board) and Alva's gossip (ashore) only show where to look - never evidence on their own.

lola.rolle: on board: galley, morale, ship's gossip

alva.rolle: ashore: bar, supply routes, village gossip; all shore roles from the dossier

geduld.regel: Only guessing costs a vein (evidence that fits nothing; an accusation without proof). Any logically fitting evidence counts, no matter how Duc found it.

zeugen.regel: Earned beforehand (trust, statements). Witnesses have their own loyalties and can lie to protect someone; an objection with evidence exposes the lie.

erbarmen_wenn: Duc honest about his own role

anhoerung.entschuldigung: People who were wrongly suspected are offered an apology after the verdict.
anhoerung.immer: The hearing always takes place, even empty-handed; then Megan judges on her own (dismissal as a roguelike consequence, not game over).
anhoerung.zoegern: Megan hesitates over the engine report: "A PX-480 doesn't just burn." (gut feeling -> mercy)

ende.regel: No overall ending: Act 1 closes with the verdict, the state of the crew and the cliffhanger. Endings for the women, the bay and the epilogues only come at the end of Act 3.
